text.title: Text
text.description: Caption or post text accompanying media

source.title: Source
source.description: Source of the caption (e.g. social_post, alt_text)

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of read-only original file

message.title: Message
message.default: Evidence ingested and stored in read-only repository.

src_id.title: Src Id
src_id.description: Source node ID (observation or claim ID)

dst_id.title: Dst Id
dst_id.description: Destination node ID (observation or claim ID)

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: Correlation rule name or code (e.g. R3_number_mismatch, R7_audio_visual_cut)

evidence_observation_ids.title: Evidence Observation Ids
evidence_observation_ids.description: IDs of observations supporting this edge; must have at least one supporting observation

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of why these nodes are linked

alternative_explanation.title: Alternative Explanation
alternative_explanation.description: Benign alternative explanation (mandatory for CONTRADICTS relations)

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique observation ID (e.g. obs_<sha256> or obs_<uuid>)

method.title: Method
method.description: Forensic method used to detect indicator

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Technical details of observed anomaly or signal

alternative_explanation.title: Alternative Explanation
alternative_explanation.description: Plausible benign explanation (mandatory for weak and moderate strength observations)

model_score.title: Model Score
model_score.description: Optional uncalibrated model score. Never represent as a global fake probability.

model_calibrated.title: Model Calibrated
model_calibrated.description: Must remain False for any pretrained ML score in compliance with forensic honesty rules.

model_name.title: Model Name
model_name.description: Name of the model if an ML analyzer was used

time_start_ms.title: Time Start Ms
time_start_ms.description: Start offset in milliseconds for time-based media

time_end_ms.title: Time End Ms
time_end_ms.description: End offset in milliseconds for time-based media

limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.description: Forensic limitations and scope bounds (mandatory for weak and moderate observations)

include_artifacts.title: Include Artifacts
include_artifacts.description: Whether to include links to derived artifacts

download_url.title: Download Url
download_url.description: URL or relative path to download the report

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Event kind (upload, exif_timestamp, scene_cut, observation, review)
